'''Droids and guards''' was a game played by young children. The [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] [[Jubnuk/Legends|Jubnuk's]] children were playing it when [[Gender/Legends|he]] left for work on the day of the [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon]], a day that ultimately proved to be his last day of employment under Jabba.
